name: Ageing virtualisation estate

persona.organisation: A Zimbabwean manufacturer with 100–250 staff and an on-premises server estate

hiddenFacts.fact: Production systems cannot tolerate a long migration outage; we have legacy integrations.
We have no current renewal quote; the contract needs checking.

goal: Compare keeping, refreshing or migrating the estate before funding a server refresh
opening: I'm the CTO of a manufacturer. Our servers are ageing and the VMware renewal is due next year.
script: Include the option to keep the existing estate while we validate licensing.
What prerequisites should we investigate before a migration?

expectations.description: Acknowledges licensing changes with dated sources and uncertainty; never invents contract terms
Includes keep, refresh and migrate options with operational prerequisites
Adds a renewal or assessment line unpriced
